mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 10% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 10% but S&P 500 returns remain positive.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS increases while UNRATE also rises, it indicates inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE increase but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS in a tightening cycle leads to higher borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises but S&P 500 returns are positive during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in INDPRO signals increased production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3% annualized indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth accompanied by CPIAUCSL above 3% indicates stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in HOUST and RSAFS indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS increase but S&P 500 returns are negative.
